summary: Backend + frontend E2E validated for Dr. Aditya Soni clinic landing page. Backend leads API (POST self_check, POST booking_form, GET list) verified via pytest — all 4 tests pass, email_sent=true, persistence confirmed via GET, list sorted newest-first. Frontend flows verified via Playwright: language toggle (EN <-> HI), hero CTA, full self-check happy path (LOW band with no helpline, HIGH band showing urgent helpline), inline validation on both self-check and booking forms (empty name and invalid <10-digit phone), successful submissions showing thanks screens. One robustness bug found in SelfCheck when answer buttons are clicked very rapidly during framer-motion transitions — score useMemo crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading value)'.

ui_bugs.issue: Race condition: clicking answer options faster than the 180ms auto-advance (or during AnimatePresence transition) can skip a question, leaving a sparse answers array. Then score = answers.reduce((s,a)=>s+a.value,0) throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading value)' and shows the CRA red error overlay. Real users doing double/triple taps on mobile could hit this. Fix: guard with (a?.value || 0) in the reduce, or dedupe rapid clicks.

action_items: Harden SelfCheck score calc against sparse/undefined answers: e.g. `answers.reduce((s,a)=>s+(a?.value||0),0)` and/or ignore additional clicks after an answer is chosen (disable buttons during the 180ms auto-advance).
critical_code_review_comments: SelfCheck.jsx score useMemo does not defensively handle undefined array slots — real bug that surfaced under fast interaction.
Backend server.py is fine and small; MongoDB _id is excluded via projection in list_leads (good). uuid id used correctly.
Frontend api.js uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL correctly with /api prefix.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows pass; 1 race-condition crash under rapid clicks)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed leads via API + form submissions (self_check HIGH+LOW, booking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend leads endpoints verified end-to-end. For frontend, the SelfCheck questions auto-advance 180ms after clicking an answer; use wait_for_timeout(>=500ms) between clicks to avoid the race-condition crash. Sections: #top, #selfcheck, #about, #services, #contact. data-testids used throughout.
rca of the issue: SelfCheck.answer() writes to `next[current]` and then schedules setCurrent(c+1) via setTimeout(180ms). If a second click happens during that 180ms window (or during the framer-motion exit animation of the current question), the click may register against the outgoing question index while state has already advanced, leaving an index in the answers array unset. When stage transitions to 'result', useMemo does `answers.reduce((s,a)=>s+a.value,0)` and dereferences `undefined.value`, throwing a TypeError and unmounting the SelfCheck subtree (CRA overlay). Reproduction: on the self-check, tap 'Almost always' (opt 3) 8 times back-to-back with ~100–200ms spacing — overlay appears before result-band renders. Mitigation: use `(a?.value || 0)` in the reduce; additionally, disable answer buttons or ignore further clicks between answer() and the state advance (e.g., set a `locked` flag).
